text: Now take that ability outside. A city is completely different from a quiet hallway. Traffic. Conversations. Footsteps. Engines. Reflections bouncing between buildings. Some of those sounds help you understand what's happening. Others can mask the quiet echoes you're trying to notice. And this is where real navigation skills, mobility tools, and experience matter. Echolocation can contribute information. It isn't a replacement for a cane, accessible signals, or learning how to travel safely.
